USGS-09427500.finding: Reclamation identifies Lake Havasu/Parker Dam (NID AZ10312; RISE location 3515), without this USGS identifier. Facility context does not resolve the displaced legacy river address or establish dam-outlet routing.

station_signature.name: YUMA MAIN CANAL WASTEWAY AT YUMA, AZ

USGS-09525000.finding: Reclamation describes the California Wasteway of Yuma Main Canal returning to the Colorado River, without this station identifier or a representative COMID. The prior USGS rejection remains; no Eleven Mile Wasteway alias is adopted.

station_signature.name: PILOT KNOB POWERPLANT INLET DIVERSION FROM AAC, CA

USGS-09526900.finding: Reclamation describes separate Pilot Knob powerplant and wasteway facilities and a return to the Colorado River. No exact cross-reference for USGS 09526900 was found. Inlet, powerplant and wasteway identities remain separate; the original IID access failure is retained. Reclamation’s Yuma Division record also identifies Rockwood Heading as a return for Pilot Knob powerplant and wasteway; this is unkeyed facility context, not an inlet-gauge match.

station_signature.name: BIG C DIV NR FISH CAMP CA

USGS-11267350.finding: USGS water-year 1998 station record explicitly keys 11267350 to a diversion from Big Creek (South Fork Merced tributary) to Lewis Fork of the Fresno River. Two dated descriptive roles are supported, not current operations or graph edges. CDEC BGF remains a candidate; the prior USGS rejection of the misconnected NHDPlus diversion remains.

USGS-11312672.finding: DWR Attachment B explicitly maps USGS 11312672 to CDEC VCU. Current CDEC notes transition of flow operation to USBR on 2025-12-02. This station alias does not resolve the conflicting Old River address.

USGS-11313200.finding: DWR 2016 Attachment B associates GLC with 11313200; current CDEC explicitly identifies 11313240 and records a 2005 relocation. GLC is withheld as a current alias for 11313200. Station equivalence and routing inheritance are not assumed.

station_signature.name: DEER C A ROAD 88 NR PIXLEY CA

USGS-355422119223201.finding: State Controller records confirm Deer Creek Storm Water District and its flood-control activity. Pixley Irrigation District's 2012 plan describes Road 88 Dam and outflow toward Alpaugh/Atwell Island districts. Neither source identifies USGS 355422119223201; gauge ownership, dam equivalence and downstream station links remain unconfirmed. The original county-directory access failure is retained. DWR GSP submission 42 references Deer Creek Storm Water District and LAFCO; the linked legacy county address redirects to a denied county page. Administrative attribution does not establish gauge ownership or a hydrography address.

USGS Data Series 756 lists a different Connection Slough station, 380000121340801; its name cannot authorize a merge with the Swing Bridge gauge.
